rules.find: if(native.profileId!==route.profileId||native.boundAccountId!==route.accountId||native.isRegularProfile!==true||native.isOffTheRecord!==false||native.accountAuthPaused===true||native.cookieRestorePending!==false||![native.browserContextId,native.cookieBindingEpoch,native.cookieRestoreEpoch].every(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value))throw Error('The native browser profile binding changed.');
rules.replace:
const checks=[native.profileId===route.profileId,native.boundAccountId===route.accountId,native.isRegularProfile===true,native.isOffTheRecord===false,native.accountAuthPaused!==true,native.cookieRestorePending===false,...[native.browserContextId,native.cookieBindingEpoch,native.cookieRestoreEpoch].map(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.length>0)];
 if(checks.some(value=>!value))throw Error('The native browser profile binding changed. [checks='+checks.map(value=>value?'1':'0').join('')+']');
